learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Chose 36 against18 and8 comparisons for descending nine-number list; locked it in.
observations.exploration: Next number gave scan8,stack0. All rest completed descending list:scan36,stack8,pops0. Switched to8…1,9; sequence automatically ran and ended scan36,stack15,pops8. Both case totals retained.
observations.reveal: Corrected to8; explained hollow stop ticks in descending list and final9 popping eight waiting values in alternate case. Every comparison pops a number or ends a turn, so linear rather than quadratic work.
observations.visual: Actual1257 ×936 dark screenshots inspected. Scan rows show triangular work, stack rows show eight hollow stops or eight solid pop ticks, answers9 shown under earlier values in second case. Full reveal legible.
